shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- FILES ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- PACKAGE ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- TRAPS ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; printf '\\n--- THEMING ---\\n'; sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json; printf '\\n--- FILES ---\\n'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort; printf '\\n--- UIKIT VERSION/DOCS ---\\n'; node -p \"require('@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version\"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; printf '\\n--- SETUP ---\\n'; rg -n \"Required setup|ThemeProvider|import '@gravity-ui/uikit\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs -g '*.md' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const p=require('fs').readFileSync('node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json','utf8'); const j=JSON.parse(p); console.log(j.version); console.log(JSON.stringify(j.exports,null,2))\"; printf '\\n--- README ---\\n'; sed -n '35,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; printf '\\n--- CURRENT ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; printf '\\n--- TYPES ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -maxdepth 3 -name '*.d.ts' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"export \\* from|declare function|declare const|interface TabsProps|type TabsProps|interface ButtonProps|Flex|Text|Card|Switch|SegmentedRadioGroup\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -100; printf '\\n--- COMPONENT DIRS ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -maxdepth 2 -type d | rg \"components/(Tabs|Button|Flex|Text|Card|SegmentedRadioGroup|ThemeProvider)\" | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc 'for d in Tabs Button Flex Text Card SegmentedRadioGroup ThemeProvider Icon Switch; do echo "--- $d"; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/$d -name '"'*.d.ts' -maxdepth 2 -print -exec sed -n '1,160p' {} \\; 2>/dev/null | head -120; done"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg '"'^(Tabs|Flex|Text|Card|ThemeProvider|Space|Layout)'"' ; printf '\\n--- d.ts ---\\n'; for d in Tabs Flex Text Card ThemeProvider; do find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -type f -iname \"*"'$d*.d.ts" | head -5; done; printf '"'\\n--- exports ---\\n'; rg -n '\"(Tabs|Flex|Text|Card|ThemeProvider)\"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'for f in node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/legacy/Tabs/Tabs.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/legacy/Tabs/TabsItem.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; do echo ---$f; sed -n '"'1,180p' "'$f; done; echo '"'--- text'; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts; echo '--- index'; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "echo tabs; sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/Tabs.d.ts; echo card; sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts; echo themeprops; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/types.d.ts; echo '--- tablist'; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/TabList/TabList.d.ts; echo '--- tab'; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/Tab/Tab.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/TabList.d.ts; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/tabs/Tab.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n \"SunIcon|MoonIcon\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons -g '*.d.ts' | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json','utf8')).version)\"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg -i 'sun|moon|theme|palette|house|home|user|chart|gear|bolt|star' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg -i '"'^(Moon|Sun|SunMoon|Brightness|Light|Dark|Theme)'"' | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg -i '(User|Person|Home|House)' | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '\"@gravity-ui/icons\"' package-lock.json | head -5; npm ls @gravity-ui/icons"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/App.tsx
@@
-import {House, Moon, PersonGear, Sun} from '@gravity-ui/icons';
+import {House, Moon, Sun} from '@gravity-ui/icons';
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"Badge\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg -i 'badge|tag|label' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Label/Label.d.ts; sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/Progress.d.ts; apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/App.tsx
@@
-import {House, Moon, PersonGear, Sun} from '@gravity-ui/icons';
+import {House, Moon, Sun} from '@gravity-ui/icons';
*** Update File: src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx
@@
-import {Badge, Button, Card, Flex, Progress, Text} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';
+import {Label, Progress, Flex, Text} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';
@@
-                                <Badge theme=\"info\">{project.status}</Badge>
+                                <Label theme=\"info\">{project.status}</Label>
*** End Patch
PATCH"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/types.d.ts; sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx
@@
-import {Label, Progress, Flex, Text} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';
+import {Card, Flex, Label, Progress, Text} from '@gravity-ui/uikit';
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\\b|dark:' src --glob '*.css' --glob '*.tsx'; npm ls @gravity-ui/icons; git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --porcelain=v1 src'
